script_text: Something explosive is brewing in your natal first house as Neptune stations retrograde. Monday through Wednesday, your fiery ruling planet Mars in your 10th House squares Saturn entering your 2nd, stirring career and money doubts. Tuesday peaks with this square, making impulsive spending dangerous. Wednesday softens as Venus in Taurus sextiles your 7th House, reviving a romantic connection. Thursday's turning point arrives as the Sun crosses into Gemini, lighting your 3rd House and opening doors for communication, learning, and short travel that reshape your perspective. Friday through Sunday, Uranus in your 5th House conjuncts natal Venus, sparking unexpected romantic chemistry or a creative breakthrough. Saturday Jupiter in Cancer trines your 9th House. Sunday is calm for rest. Best day is Wednesday, Venus sextiles your 7th House. Worst day is Tuesday when Mars squares Saturn. Pause before signing any financial agreement this week. Follow for daily updates.
